compatibility_with_current_corpus.reason: Legacy RPCs expect remote documentos row contract and Portuguese hierarchy fields; current507 live records use Chroma and English field names. No remote RPC DDL/implementation found in application files; remote availability not tested.
compatibility_with_current_corpus.identity: Article number not globally unique: retain stable record ID, source, sector, registry mapping. norm_id/normative_status missing438/507; no norm_id-only filtering.
compatibility_with_current_corpus.unavailable_structured_locators: No paragraph/inciso/caput metadata in live507 inventory; do not claim exact indexed subdivision matching.
compatibility_with_current_corpus.temporal_boundary: Metadata locates structure; vector search ranks relevance. Both must pass TemporalIntent, VersionFilter, TemporalGroundingContext and selected StructuredOutputV2 before normative final answer.
compatibility_with_current_corpus.comparison: Current RagService.retrieve async returns list[RetrievedChunk], validates sector and nonempty question, checks index count, uses existing/precomputed query embedding, filters sector/excluded_sources; legacy tools sync return formatted strings and cannot preserve this contract.

limitations: Remote RPC schemas/SQL logic and server order unverified: no application DDL found.
Installed dependency behavior is local environment evidence, not guaranteed for other installations.
